project_type: Monorepo: backend/ Fastify 5 + TypeScript (ESM, Node 22) with WebSocket hub; frontend/ Next.js 16.3.5 (React 19, zustand, Tailwind 4). Live auction state is a Room aggregate persisted as file snapshots; Postgres (Supabase) only for Manager Mode/archive.
language: TypeScript (backend ESM with .js import suffixes; frontend TSX). Migrations are SQL, scripts are .mjs.
build_system: backend: tsc (tsconfig.build.json, rootDir src). frontend: next build; `npm run typecheck` (tests/type-boundary.mjs) forbids importing anything under backend/ from frontend.
test_framework: backend vitest (tests/*.test.ts, helper tests/helpers.ts `fixture()`); frontend node+Playwright scripts in frontend/tests/*.mjs (see recall-ui.mjs: esbuild bundle from ../../backend/node_modules + chromium).
build_command: cd backend; npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit   |   cd frontend; npx next build
test_command: cd backend; npx vitest run   |   cd frontend; npm run typecheck
verification_instructions: Baseline today: backend tsc passes; vitest = 199 pass / 6 fail. The 6 pre-existing, unrelated failures are in tests/skip-vote.test.ts (5) and the skip-voting case in tests/integration.test.ts (1) (expected 3 skip votes, got 4). snapshot_or_generated_files: Generated DB types are hand-maintained in the existing style: supabase/types/database.types.ts and backend/src/types/database.generated.d.ts. Update both to match the new migration.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. Never start long-lived dev servers. Work in place at C:\Users\ASUS\projects\Realtime -Auction (no worktree). The tree has UNCOMMITTED earlier work (player image fixes, ManagerCommandCenter, CupTrophy3D, backend/src/modules/manager-mode/postgres-manager.repository.ts): never revert or clobber it; `git add` only files you changed, by name; never push. The six FC26 CSVs in the repo root are untracked; do not commit or move them. The underdog file is FC26_Underdogs.csv (plural); the brief says FC26_Underdog.csv, so support both.
contribution_requirements: Extend, do not rebuild. Keep auctions without retention behaving exactly as before. Use only the existing WebSocket real-time mechanism. Backend validates everything (never trust client prices/paths). Money is half-Cr integer units on the backend (15 Cr = 30 units) and Cr numbers on the wire. No placeholder/fake data in UI. Follow ui-ux-pro-max rules: no emoji icons (use lucide-react), cursor-pointer, focus states, stable hover, contrast, prefers-reduced-motion.
key_patterns: RoomManager.mutate(code,(room,events)=>...) is the only write path (per-room lock, assertRoom, CAS commit, publish events then hub sends full ROOM_STATE). AuctionEngine.execute handles WS commands (commandSchema in auction.schemas.ts; member-level commands before the host-only else-branch). DomainError via requireThat(cond, code, message, status). Frontend: services/* wrap api.get/post and webSocketService.send; stores/auction.store.ts holds ROOM_STATE snapshot; services/contract.ts maps DTOs; types/backend.ts mirrors the wire contract by hand (parseServerEvent ignores unknown event names unless added to `names`). Apply-script pattern: backend/scripts/apply-cup-schema.mjs (dry run prints schema; --apply runs SQL, verifies RLS, registers migration).
directory_structure: backend/src/{domain,schemas,config,modules/{auction,rooms,players,teams,results,manager-mode,...},realtime,repositories}; backend/tests; backend/scripts (apply-*-schema.mjs); backend/data (bundled CSVs); supabase/{migrations,types,docs}; frontend/src/{app,components/{auction,room,results,team,ui,shared,...},services,stores,types,lib}; frontend/tests; repo root holds FC26_*.csv.
